title: A note on the stability of surfaces along null cones under area-preserving variations
summary: In this note we investigate a notion of stability for spacelike cross sections of a null cone under area preserving variations that has been introduced in previous work by Kröncke and the author. Here, we consider null cones with spherical cross sections in a $4$-dimensional spacetime and show that the Hawking energy of a stable cross section admits a non-negative lower bound provided the dominant energy condition holds.
